title: Hyperbolic and Exponential Functions: y = a/(x + p) + q and y = abˣ⁺ᵖ + q
seo_title: Grade 11 Hyperbolic and Exponential Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Revise the effect of a and q and investigate the effect of p on the graphs of the functions defined by y = a/(x + p) + q and y = ab<sup>x + p</sup> + q where b > 0, b ≠ 1.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 11 worksheets: hyperbolas y = a/(x + p) + q and exponential graphs y = abˣ⁺ᵖ + q, asymptotes, axes of symmetry and equations. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • y = ax + p + q has asymptotes x = −p and y = q.
  • Its axes of symmetry pass through (−p; q) with gradients 1 and −1.
  • y = abx + p + q has the asymptote y = q; p only moves the graph left or right.
  • Find a or b by substituting a point on the graph.

Examples

Example

y = 2/(x − 1) + 3

asymptotes x = 1, y = 3

Answer: axes: y = x + 2 and y = −x + 4

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
x = pThe vertical asymptote is x = −p.
The asymptotep does not move y = q.
x + pSubstitute into x + p, not x.

The axes of symmetry of y = 3x − 1 − 3 have gradients 1 and −1. Which is the one with gradient 1?
items.e: The axes pass through the point (1; −3) where the asymptotes meet. y = x + c: −3 = 1 + c, so y = x − 4.
